requirements: Use the route delivery context for units, data losses, inspection, runtime scope and recovery.
A declared operation is not a claim of native qualification; consult scoped source-bound receipts.

readVector.purpose: Read one bounded 2D GeoJSON or GeoPackage vector layer with its declared CRS.

reproject.purpose: Transform vector coordinates to an explicit EPSG CRS.

buffer.purpose: Buffer vector geometry by a distance in metres; a projected metre CRS is required.

clip.purpose: Intersect features with an axis-aligned rectangle in the current layer CRS.

centroid.purpose: Reduce each projected polygon or multipolygon to its planar area-weighted centre of mass, retaining attributes and CRS.
semantics: Requires polygon geometry and a projected CRS; reproject explicitly first. The point can lie outside a concave polygon or inside a hole. Geometry and area are lost; this is not point-on-surface or a geodesic centre.

examples.purpose: Find the centre of a known rectangular parcel.
